name: branding-violet-brand-board-with-photo-grid-store-icon-and-browser
title: Bento of violet tiles: logo over a silhouette, construction grid, gradient symbol, store card, home-screen icon, cards, browser and tagline
whatItIs: A black-framed grid of tiles: the white logo over a violet-toned profile portrait, a construction grid with circles, a large gradient-white symbol on violet, an App Store card with the icon and a blue GET, a phone corner with the icon among iOS apps, two floating business cards, a violet browser mockup and a tall portrait with highlighted tagline 'Where Intelligence Meets Innovation.'
whatItMeans: Cohesive and premium; one violet unites photo, UI and stationery.
techniques: Build a bento of applications in one colour.
Highlight tagline words with violet bars.
Show construction and store views together.

vocabulary.definition: A tile grid of brand applications.
A bar behind chosen tagline words.
A portrait in one colour plus black.
